evidence.irr:
**irr 50（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　『Formulary exclusion effectively encourages patients and providers to seek alternative treatments, make a complex and time-intensive request for medical exemptions, or pay 100% of the cost of a drug.』（Item 1A Risk Factors — 第三者支払者による価格・償還（台帳の旧根拠が唯一70の根拠として挙げた『フォーミュラリの摩擦』の当該箇所））——旧根拠の主張が原本では**逆向き**であることの決定打　『impose step edits that require patients to try alternative, including generic, treatments before authorizing payment for our products』（Item 1A Risk Factors — 同上）——顧客(支払者)が患者を代替へ強制できる＝移行障壁の反対　『certain PBMs, other similar organizations and third party payors may exert negotiating leverage by requiring incremental rebates, discounts or other concessions from manufacturers in order to maintain formulary positions』（Item 1A Risk Factors — 同上）——棚を維持するのに当社が払う＝向きが逆　『We do not promote JAKAFI or our other drug products to specialty pharmacies or wholesalers, and they do not set or determine demand for JAKAFI or our other drug products.』（Item 1A Risk Factors — 限られた specialty pharmacy への依存）——流通側との関係に顧客拘束が無いことを会社自身が述べる　『Although we believe we can find alternative channels to distribute JAKAFI or our other drug products on relatively short notice』（Item 1A Risk Factors — 同上）——経路は短期で置換可能＝摩擦の不在　『We hold patents that cover the composition of matter and use of ruxolitinib and its salt. These patents, including applicable extensions, currently expire in mid and late 2028』（Item 1 Business — JAKAFI）——実体の堀は特許残存期間＝`expiry` の領分で irr の二重計上になる　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『We face significant competition from organizations, particularly fully integrated pharmaceutical companies, that are pursuing pharmaceuticals that are competitive with our drug products and our drug candidates.』 ／ 『impose step edits that require patients to try alternative, including generic, treatments before authorizing payment for our products』 ／ 『we have three qualified third-party contract manufacturers from which we can source drug substance』　《射程》—（50なので射程は問わない）　《検問と反証の経緯》【evidence_gap＝この6社で最も明白】台帳の旧根拠366字のうち**約350字が『85ではない』の証明**（qualif/certifは自社サプライヤの認定・FDA/EMAは自社が取得する側・代替不能性は特許由来でexpiryの二重計上）で、70 を支えているのは末尾の**『処方習慣・フォーミュラリの摩擦で70』の一行だけ、しかも原本の引用が一つも無い**。v9.9.144 が名指しで禁じた『85を否定した残りで70に置く』型そのもの。
【自分の結論への反証＝旧根拠の主張を原本で確かめた】524,838字を走査。(a)**『処方習慣』**: 'prescrib' は**全文4件**で、3件は同一のリスク箇条書き『Side effects…could **lessen the frequency with which physicians decide to prescribe** our products; **encourage physicians to stop prescribing**…』＝**処方が離れる**話、残る1件はオフラベル販促規制。**処方の粘着性を述べる文は0件**。(b)**『フォーミュラリの摩擦』**: 'formulary' 7件は**全件が向きが逆**——『PBMs…can…**exclude drugs from their formularies in favor of competitor drugs**』『**Formulary exclusion effectively encourages patients and providers to seek alternative treatments**』『payors may exert negotiating leverage by **requiring incremental rebates, discounts or other concessions from manufacturers in order to maintain formulary positions**』『**impose step edits that require patients to try alternative, including generic, treatments**』。フォーミュラリは**当社が金を払って棚を維持し、顧客が患者を代替へ追い立てる機構**で、顧客が乗り換え費用を負う機構ではない。旧根拠の唯一の70主張は**原本に反証される**。
【他の候補も潰した】switch/switching **0件** / **barrier 0件** / lock-in 0 / installed base 0 / **multi-year 0件** / long-term contract 0 / renewal 0 / churn 0 / REMS 0。'exclusiv' 69件を分類すると license 13・規制/特許のexclusivity 26・その他27で**顧客拘束は0件**（顧客関連に見える5件も Novartis/Syndax等への**導出入ライセンス**と当社が指名する『exclusive wholesaler』＝流通側）。specialty pharmacy 18件は**向きが逆**——『**We do not promote** JAKAFI…to specialty pharmacies or wholesalers, and **they do not set or determine demand**』『they…**may be reluctant to be part of our distribution network**』、極めつけは『**Although we believe we can find alternative channels to distribute JAKAFI…on relatively short notice**』＝会社自身が流通経路を短期で置換可能と述べる。
【二重計上の回避】原本は『We hold patents that cover the composition of matter and use of ruxolitinib…currently **expire in mid and late 2028**』と書く。実体の堀は**特許の残存期間**で、門は `expiry` で別に測っている。irr で数え直せば二重計上。規約どおり50。
